request.description:
ulw/qxj add --run-id run_<hex> so the store opens, but settle then calls addressForSettlement, which requires the attempt's executor state on the machine running settle; a cloud attempt's state lives in the factory container, so the command the header prints refuses with 'this host holds no state … nothing to release'. Tests compare strings only. Needs a factory-side release or a different named command for cloud holds.
evidence: internal/reconcile/settle.go:494-499; internal/reconcile/settle_command.go:18
